name: TC-SR-007 — Leader打回买手必填调整意见 [P1]
description: 验证打回买手：调整意见必填10-500字、记录打回次数
page: 迭代详情-试拍与评审 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('打回买手')); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, [class*=modal]'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('确认') || b.textContent.includes('打回')); return { found: true, textarea: !!textarea, confirmBtn: !!confirmBtn, placeholder: textarea?.placeholder }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); const textarea = modal?.querySelector('textarea'); if (textarea) { const short = '太短了'; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(textarea, short); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return { input: short, length: short.length }; } return { found: false }; })()
steps.description: 输入少于10字验证最小长度

_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 点击打回买手
2. 验证弹窗展示调整意见输入框
3. 输入少于10字验证
4. 输入超过500字验证
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 弹窗展示调整意见文本框
2. 调整意见必填10-500字
3. 不满足字数时不允许确认
4. 确认后迭代进入RETURNED_TO_BUYER
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/试拍与评审
